en.headline: Special traffic arrangements for World Triathlon Cup in Central and Wan Chai
en.dek: Transport Department says Expo Drive will close from Wednesday and further road closures will apply near the harbourfront on Saturday and Sunday.
body: The Transport Department reminded the public on Tuesday that special traffic and transport arrangements will be implemented in phases in Central and Wan Chai from Wednesday to Sunday to facilitate the 2026 World Triathlon Cup Hong Kong.

From 10am on 4 November to about 8pm on 8 November, the section of Expo Drive between Legislative Council Road and Expo Drive Central will be temporarily closed. On 7 November from 1am to about 2pm and on 8 November from 1am to about 6pm, road closures and diversions will apply in the vicinity of the Central Harbourfront and Wan Chai North, including Yiu Sing Street, Lung Wo Road, Lung Hop Street and Lung Tat Path.

To tie in with the closures, certain Citybus routes operating via Lung Wo Road or Yiu Sing Street will be temporarily diverted via Connaught Road Central during the main event periods, and the bus stop on Man Yiu Street near Two International Finance Centre will be suspended.

The department advised the public and visitors to use public transport as far as possible to avoid congestion. The Transport Department and police will monitor the situation and may adjust arrangements if needed.

zh.headline: 三項鐵人世界盃中區及灣仔分階段實施特別交通安排
zh.dek: 運輸署指博覽道由周三起封閉，周六及周日中環海濱及灣仔北一帶將進一步封路改道。
body: 運輸署周二提醒市民，為配合2026三項鐵人世界盃香港站，中區及灣仔由周三至周日將分階段實施特別交通及運輸安排。
11月4日上午10時至11月8日晚上約8時，介乎立法會道至博覽道中的一段博覽道將臨時封閉。11月7日凌晨1時至下午約2時及11月8日凌晨1時至下午約6時，中環海濱及灣仔北一帶將實施封路及改道，包括耀星街、龍和道、龍合街及龍達徑等。
為配合封路，部分途經龍和道或耀星街的城巴路線將在主要賽事時段臨時改經干諾道中，民耀街近國際金融中心二期的巴士站亦會暫停使用。
運輸署呼籲市民及旅客盡量使用公共運輸服務，以免交通擠塞。運輸署及警方會密切監察情況，有需要時可調整安排。
